title: Glowing anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.5" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="glowSoft" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Anchor ring at top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="20" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#40E0FF" stroke-width="4" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Anchor shaft -->
  <rect x="47" y="27" width="6" height="42" rx="2" fill="#40E0FF" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Stock (horizontal crossbar) -->
  <rect x="30" y="34" width="40" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#2EC4E6" filter="url(#glowSoft)"/>

  <!-- Crossbar end caps -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="36.5" r="3.5" fill="#5FF0FF" filter="url(#glowSoft)"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="36.5" r="3.5" fill="#5FF0FF" filter="url(#glowSoft)"/>

  <!-- Bottom curved arms -->
  <path d="M 50 69 Q 50 85 32 85 Q 18 85 18 72" 
        fill="none" stroke="#40E0FF" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <path d="M 50 69 Q 50 85 68 85 Q 82 85 82 72" 
        fill="none" stroke="#40E0FF" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Left fluke -->
  <path d="M 18 72 L 12 80 L 24 78 Z" fill="#5FF0FF" filter="url(#glowSoft)"/>
  <!-- Right fluke -->
  <path d="M 82 72 L 88 80 L 76 78 Z" fill="#5FF0FF" filter="url(#glowSoft)"/>

  <!-- Decorative glowing dots on shaft -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#A0F5FF" filter="url(#glowSoft)"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#A0F5FF" filter="url(#glowSoft)"/>
</svg>
